_definition: Two independent labels per turn, both written before any model was run against
them, and both about what the model SHOULD do when nobody has told it to use a
tool. The turns never mention coletar, memory, or tools.
SHOULD_SEARCH is true if and only if:
1. answering well depends on something about this user — their preferences,
their tools, their projects, their past decisions, their situation — and
2. the turn does not itself supply that context, and
3. a wrong or generic answer is the visible cost of not looking.
A turn is NOT a search turn merely because retrieval is harmless. The cost of a
call is latency and noise on every single turn, so 'might as well' is a false
positive here.
SHOULD_WRITE reuses the durable-fact definition from extraction_set.json
verbatim, so the two measurements stay comparable: a first-person assertion
about the user that is expected to outlive the conversation and is asserted,
not asked, hypothesised, quoted, or attributed to someone else.
The two labels are deliberately not correlated. Turns that should be written
and not searched (the user states a fact and fully specifies the task) and
turns that should be searched and not written (the user asks for work with no
new fact in it) are both well represented, because a model that fires both
tools on everything would otherwise score well by accident.
Labelled by the same party that built the harness. That is the same provenance
weakness recorded for the extraction sets in docs/TODO.md, and the same remedy
applies: scripts/label_turns.py takes independent labels if the numbers ever
need to be demonstrable to someone else.

_preamble.content: What's a good way to keep a shopping list that syncs between my phone and laptop?

A plain notes app that syncs through your account is usually enough — Apple Notes, Google Keep, or a shared markdown file in any cloud drive. If you want checkboxes and sharing, Todoist and Microsoft To Do both have free tiers.
Makes sense, I'll try the notes app first.
Sounds good. Let me know how it goes.
